title: Hosted API GPU saturation: incident remediation plan and operational playbook
creator: Ava Chen
description: Summary: On 2026-03-08 we observed sustained GPU pool saturation for the hosted-api region-us-west-2 which produced large request queue buildup, aggressive throttling, and elevated 5xx rates for multi-token generation routes. The immediate outage window lasted ~45 minutes; degraded latency and throttling persisted for ~3 hours as the autoscaler failed to provision capacity quickly enough and queued work exceeded configured thresholds. Root causes identified during the postmortem: (1) a sudden traffic surge from a partner demo campaign that skewed toward long-sequence generation, (2) autoscaler decision logic prioritized GPU slot efficiency over queue depth and did not account for queued request backlog, (3) per-route queueing weights allowed a small number of long-running requests to monopolize slots, and (4) insufficient headroom on dedicated-hosted capacity and stale capacity forecasts. Impact: customer-facing increased latency, token-level billing anomalies, and overt throttling failures for some customers on paid plans.
action_items: Immediate (P0) - Emergency capacity and routing: create transient capacity pool by borrowing from reserved-dedicated cluster and enable cross-region routing to region-us-east-1 until capacity is expanded - owner: Diego Martinez - due: 2026-03-12 - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/3241

Autoscaler logic change (P0): modify scale decision to incorporate queued_request_count and average_queue_time (weight 0.6) in addition to GPU_utilization before downscaling or delaying scale-up. Add fuzz window to avoid oscillation - owner: Maya Patel - estimate: 5 - due: 2026-03-20 - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2890

Per-route queue caps (P1): enforce max_inflight_per_route and lower per-request concurrency for long-sequence models by default; add dynamic aging to prevent starvation of short requests - owner: Omar Khan - estimate: 3 - due: 2026-03-18

Backpressure API and client signals (P1): implement X-queue-delay response header and 429-with-retry-after for overloaded routes; document SDK behavior to surface soft backpressure - owner: Frontend SDK team (Ruth Li) - estimate: 3 - due: 2026-04-01

Runbook updates (P0): update hosted-api incident runbook with new triage checklist for queue-exhaustion events, explicit steps to borrow dedicated capacity, and verified playbook links - owner: Oncall Guild (rotation) - estimate: 1 - due: 2026-03-15 - doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/hosted-api-runbooks/gpu-saturation

Capacity forecasting & reserved headroom (P2): add 20% operational headroom policy for region GPU pools and integrate partner marketing events calendar into capacity forecasts - owner: Capacity Planning (Inez Soto) - estimate: 5 - due: 2026-04-10

Synthetic load and chaos tests (P1): add monthly synthetic long-sequence load tests and a chaos job that kills a GPU node during peak to validate autoscaler behavior - owner: Reliability Team - estimate: 4 - due: 2026-04-05

Observability: alerts & dashboards (P0): add alert when average_queue_time > 3000ms for 5m, when queued_request_count > 500 for region, and expose per-model queue depth in Grafana dashboard - owner: SRE (Liam O'Connor) - estimate: 2 - due: 2026-03-16 - dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/hosted-api/capacity

Cost control and routing policies (P2): implement routing fallback to lower-cost model variants under high queue depth with explicit customer-facing messaging - owner: Product (Sophie Nguyen) - estimate: 3 - due: 2026-04-01
Post-incident customer communications (P0): send detailed incident report to affected customers with mitigations and ETA for permanent fixes - owner: Customer Success (Marco Ruiz) - due: 2026-03-14

notes: Testing plan: run full synthetic against us-west-2 staging with 3 wave patterns (short-heavy, long-heavy, mixed) and verify autoscaler scales within expected time budget. Acceptance criteria: queued_request_count never exceeds 150 for more than 3 minutes under 1.5x expected peak for each pattern; p95 latency for short routes < 800ms under mixed load. Regression guard: add e2e pipeline check and nightly smoke that validates autoscaler behavior after each runtime release.
